thread:
sanjay: seeing a weird one — warm GPU pool ramping but pods not binding, lots of pending tiny-gpu pods. noticed node labels got reset during a rolling config update :/

eva: ugh. which labels?

sanjay: node.k8s.redwood/warm-pool=true removed on a subset in eu-west1-rackB. taints still there though (gpu-reserved:NoSchedule). scheduler won't pack them into warm nodes so pods keep bouncing to cold nodes -> cold capacity spike.

jin: is this the config-agent rollout from last night? we flipped label-sync to async. maybe a race.

sanjay: yeah that rollout timestamp matches. label-sync pod logs show errors around 02:11Z. snippet:
```
I0325 02:11:12 label-sync.go:183] failed to apply labels to node gpu-eu-west1-12: conflict: resource version mismatch
```

harper: impact scope? any customer-facing latency increase?

sanjay: SDK inference queues saw 2x p50 for ~6m in eu-west1 — mostly cold startup overhead. cost alert triggered for burst GPUs. no API errors surfaced.

ops-bot: Incident alert: eu-west1 GPU cold-pool cost > $threshold for 10m. Tag: cost-spike, owner: eng-platform

eva: quick mitigation: can we temporarily untaint warm nodes so scheduler can place until labels are reconciled?

jin: +1 for temporary untaint. alternative is force-relabel by node-exporter but that's riskier.

sanjay: doing `kubectl taint nodes gpu-eu-west1-12 gpu-reserved:NoSchedule-` on affected nodes now.

harper: also start a relabel job: `kubectl label node gpu-eu-west1-12 node.k8s.redwood/warm-pool=true --overwrite` for the ones missing. do in small batches.

jin: will patch the label-sync to use optimistic retries and add a 5s jitter. open PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/6127

eva: good. after relabeling we should reapply the taint: `kubectl taint nodes <node> gpu-reserved:NoSchedule=true:NoSchedule` and then bounce a few pods to validate placement.

sanjay: relabel job done for rackB subset, untaint applied. scheduling improved, cold-pool usage dropping.

harper: leaving a note for oncall: revert the untaint after label-sync fix is live. this was a config roll that lost atomicity.

jin: merged the retry/jitter fix, will roll tomorrow 03:30Z with cautious canary.

eva: cost team, FYI — cost alert resolved, but we should run a short eval of warm-pool efficiency after the fix.

sanjay: filing follow-up ticket for warm-pool reconciliation testing + add behavioral test: assert label+taint invariants during config rollouts. ticket: infra#4381

harper: thanks all. short postmortem in #postmortems once PR rolls. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Note: automated billing alert cleared at 3432110400.
